items.title: Study Quest hub
items.body: The hub with CS 379 Ethical Hacking (Test 2), CR 370 Origins (Test 3) and SC 141 Astronomy (Test 3). One sign-in works for every guide, with separate callsigns and leaderboards.

items.title: Cleaner layout
items.body: Chapter cards, buttons, footer and stat tiles are lined up.

items.title: New guide: MA 224 Discrete Math (Test 3)
items.body: Sections 5.1 to 7.3, with a Proofs tab: workshop, proof builder, counterexamples and find the error.

items.title: Side menu
items.body: A menu button in every guide lets you switch guides from anywhere.

items.title: Study tools update
items.body: Knowledge studied progress and daily streaks, review of missed questions and weak spots, timed tests, saved questions, search and a printable cheat sheet. A Verses page for CR 370 and a Planets page for SC 141. A suggestion box and Report a problem button. Hub music, mute and animation settings, and back up and restore for your progress.
